item: divi/contact-form: module.decoration.boxShadow, module.decoration.transform and module.decoration.spacing as the SUBMIT BUTTON's shadow, lift and padding
reason: Measured on the real Divi 5.15.1 (scratch check after the kit-form probe: a form with a red hard shadow, 14px 28px padding and a hover lift at module.decoration.*): all three land on div.et_pb_contact_form_container, the whole form, never on the submit button (button: box-shadow none, padding 6px 20px, transform none, rest and hover; container: the shadow, padding 14px 28px, and on hover matrix(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, -4)). The probe saw only a stylesheet difference (css-only, nothing inside the form changed) for the shadow and lift, and a narrower form for the padding. The button's own button.decoration.boxShadow, button.decoration.transform and button.decoration.spacing are the paths that reach it (kf-button-shadow-element-*, kf-button-lift-element, kf-button-padding-element PASS): the opposite of divi/button. Note on evidence: the finding that these module-level values land on the form container rests on a one-off manual ancestor-by-ancestor check of computed styles in a real browser (a scratch script, not committed), not on a committed probe; the committed probe results show only the css-only / narrower-form symptoms.
